title: The Ledger Resurfaces
payload: A dock boy brings the missing ledger to the hero, wrapped in sailcloth. One page is cut out. Show who sent him only through what he lets slip; do not name the sender.

title: A Watcher on the Quay
payload: Two turns after the ledger returns, the hero notices the same hooded figure for the second time. The figure leaves when seen. Do not reveal who it is.
